# WP-20 energy hooks: contract for the sub-agents of `w2-wp20-energy`

T = ticket folder, S = `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏙️bim/🗿️artifacts/🏢️model/🏅️standards/🔖️1/🪆️subsets/✳️any`, I = `S/🧬️schema/💡️inferences`. Binding: `T/r12-wave-brief.md`, `T/r11-finish-brief.md`, `T/r13-audit-*.md`, `T/r12-w2-wp20-contract.md` (this file).
The coordinator of the package is agent `w2-wp20-energy` (writes `T/r12-exec-w2-wp20-energy.md`); sub-agents write `T/r12-exec-w2-wp20-energy-<part>.md`.

## Authored vocabulary (written, generated by `T/r12-w2-wp20-energy-model.ts` into the snapshot, patches, facets)
* `ModelSnapshot.space_conditions: BTreeMap<space id, SpaceConditions>` (NOT an element: keyed by the id of the space it conditions, not in `taken`/`exists`, cascades with `delete-space`). `SpaceConditions { occupancy: Option<String>, occupancy_density: Option<f64> (persons/m²), heating_setpoint, cooling_setpoint: Option<f64> (°C), ventilation_rate: Option<f64> (L/s per m² floor), lighting_power_density, equipment_power_density: Option<f64> (W/m²), schedule: Option<String> }`; `SpaceConditions::empty()`, `.heated()` (heating set point), `.conditioned()` (heating or cooling set point). Rules: `S/🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔥️conditions` (`conditions_problem`, `window_thermal_problem`, `door_thermal_problem`).
* `WindowType.{u_value, g_value, frame_fraction}: Option<f64>`; `DoorType.u_value: Option<f64>`.
* Thermal zones are the existing `zones` (category free text; "Thermal" by convention). No new entity.
* Mutation leaves (tags 20000..20002, modules `crate::mutations::{set_space_conditions, remove_space_conditions, set_type_thermal_data}`): `SetSpaceConditions { id, occupancy, occupancy_density, heating_setpoint, cooling_setpoint, ventilation_rate, lighting_power_density, equipment_power_density, schedule: Option<Assigned<Option<..>>> }` (sparse, first use creates the record, `Assigned::new(None)` clears a field; `SetSpaceConditions::stating(id, &record)` states a whole record), `RemoveSpaceConditions { id }`, `SetTypeThermalData { id (window OR door type), u_value, g_value, frame_fraction: Option<Assigned<Option<f64>>> }` (door: only `u_value`).

## Derived (inference `energy-envelope`, `I/🌡️energy-envelope/🦀️.rs`; graph kinds `Envelope(space)` and `EnergyTotals(EnergyScope)`)
Exists only when the model states conditions for at least one space (otherwise the two maps are empty).
* `ModelInference.energy_envelopes: BTreeMap<space id, EnvelopeSpace>`; `EnvelopeSpace { space, storey, zone, conditioned, heated, floor_area, volume, height, open_length, surfaces: Vec<EnvelopeSurface>, issues }`.
* `EnvelopeSurface { id ("<space>/w1", "/o1" window or door, "/f1" floor, "/c1" ceiling), kind: SurfaceKind {Wall, CurtainWall, Floor, Ceiling, Window, Door}, element (wall/opening id, "<storey>/floor"), parent (host surface id of a window/door), boundary: Boundary {Exterior, Ground, Adjacent, Adiabatic}, adjacent (neighbour space id), area (net), gross_area, azimuth (deg clockwise from true north, 0 for horizontal), tilt (gbXML: 0 faces up/ceiling-roof, 90 wall, 180 floor), u_value: Option<f64>, g_value: Option<f64>, frame_fraction, polygon: Vec<Vec3> (building coordinates, counter-clockwise seen from outside) }`.
* gbXML mapping: Wall: Exterior -> ExteriorWall, Ground -> UndergroundWall, Adjacent/Adiabatic -> InteriorWall; Floor: Ground -> SlabOnGrade, Exterior -> ExposedFloor, else InteriorFloor; Ceiling: Exterior -> Roof, else Ceiling (InteriorFloor of the space above is not exported twice: `Adjacent`/`Adiabatic` surfaces appear in both spaces with `adjacent` set, gbXML wants one `Surface` with two `AdjacentSpaceId`: pair them by (min,max space, geometry)).
* `ModelInference.energy_totals: BTreeMap<String, EnergyTotals>` keyed `zone:<id>`, `building:<id>`, `project`; `EnergyTotals { spaces, floor_area, volume, envelope_area (A), a_over_v, transmission (H_T, W/K), h_t_prime (H'_T with dU_WB 0.05), opaque_by_sector, window_by_sector, solar_by_sector (8 entries, COMPASS N..NW), roof_area, floor_envelope_area, glazing_area, glazing_ratio, solar_aperture, mean_u_opaque, mean_u_window, missing }`.
* U-values: ISO 6946 (`I/🌡️energy-envelope/🧱️thermal`), windows/doors authored. Diagnostics: `energy.thermal-data-missing`, `energy.open-boundary`, `energy.conditions-missing` (en + de rows in `⚠️diagnostics/💬️messages`).
* Examples: `house` and `office` carry conditions and window/door thermal data (`T/r12-w2-wp20-examples.ts`). House space ids: `sp-b1 sp-b2 sp-g1..g5 sp-u1..u4 sp-a1`; the roof space `sp-a1` has no conditions.

## Rules of the road
Same as the wave brief: gate for every cargo call (`"$T/🚦️gate.sh" <label> -- cargo ...`, label = your label), no Grep tool, no modifying git commands, surgical edits of shared files after re-reading them, every file compile-atomic (land a type with all its uses), check `--lib --tests` through the gate after each step. Peers' in-progress work may break the crate (components/MEP/rules are being merged): confirm an error is yours before fixing it, otherwise wait and re-check. Python (no `python -` on stdin; write the script to a file; `PYTHONUTF8=1`); never write files with `open(path, "w")` over a file a running bun may hold: write `new.tmp` in the same directory, then `os.replace`. Path limit 256 characters.

## Coordinator rulings (apply AFTER `T/r13-blessed.flag`; nothing of this is in the crate yet)
1. No duplicated derivations: every `EnvelopeSurface` gets `holder: String` (the id of the slab, roof, wall, curtain wall, ceiling or opening whose construction gives the surface its layers; `element` stays the host/element id as now) and `construction: String` (the id of the wall/slab/roof/window/door/curtain-wall type). The IO `🧱️holders` copy of the U-value/holder rule is removed: exports read these fields from the inference.
2. Curtain walls get thermal data: `CurtainWallType.{u_value, g_value, frame_fraction}: Option<f64>` (U of the whole facade element, g of the glazing, mullion share of the area) via the generator (`windowThermalFields`-style constant spread into the `CurtainWallType` row of `r12-w2-wp19-frame-model.ts`, docs in `r12-w2-wp20-energy-model.ts`), `SetTypeThermalData` accepts a curtain wall type id (all three fields), `window_thermal_problem` rules reused, the inference gives a curtain wall surface its authored U (no more `energy.thermal-data-missing` for typed curtain walls), editor rows and IO (gbXML `Opening`/`WindowType`, energy bridge fenestration) write them. A mullion psi is not modelled (the frame fraction covers the mullion share); justify in the report.
3. gbXML XSD: no download without the user's approval; keep the structural oracle (open item for the user).
